name: EPIC 206516525
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 15.2 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206516525 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.166344 (16th-84th percentiles 14.922709-15.469253), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,039 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.81 solar masses and 15.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,451 K at its surface.
